name: THE SUMERIAN — REVIEW & SHOT STATUS v1.1

parameters.content:
## REVIEW ACTIONS (human only) — webhook entry only
**Human → PRODUCTION FORMS v1.1 (Shot Review Form) → protected webhook → R01A.** No form lives here.
APPROVE → APPROVED · REJECT → REJECTED · REQUEST_REVISION → REVISION_REQUESTED + ChatGPT brief (same shot_id, version + 1, authorized=false). Never regenerates.

## SHOT STATUS LOOKUP
GET ?shot_id=…&version=… → every version, **archive_url preferred** (archive_provider, archive_asset_id, public_id).

## LTX CREDENTIAL CHECK (zero cost)
GET a non-existent job id. **404 not_found = key valid**, 401 = key invalid. Never submits a generation.

## ARCHIVE REPAIR (no LTX call)
For ARCHIVE_FAILED / ARCHIVING clips: re-uploads the stored temporary LTX URL to Cloudinary (max 3 attempts), then REVIEW_REQUIRED. If the LTX URL already expired this fails cleanly; recover the file manually.
